source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
If this unit isn't **battle-shocked** in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), you may roll 1 D6 as a **psychic roll** for it. Then:

- a roll of 1 makes this unit battle-shocked
- you pick 1 enemy unit it can see within 18", which is **suppressed** until your next turn starts

A **suppressed** unit's attacks get −1 to **[Hit rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls)**.
